explication: doxx is a terminal-native Word document viewer and exporter. The main workflow is to open a DOCX, parse its content into structured document elements, then view and navigate it interactively or export it in a chosen format. Document parsing covers formatting, headings, lists, numbering, tables, and equations; additional capabilities include search, clipboard copying, color, and terminal image display. The graph follows documented capabilities and shown calls; dashed edges mark relationships whose implementation was not visible in the excerpts.
